Definition: from G1123 and G1107; to tell abroad:--make known.
BiblicalUsage: This word means to make known abroad, to tell a thing widely, and it stands in the King James text at the verse where the shepherds make known what was told them about the child. It does not appear in the Greek text most modern Bibles follow, where the verse simply says they made it known.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the shepherds' telling is the first evangelism, whether the word carries its full prefix or not; they heard, they saw, and they could not keep it to themselves.
